## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The rubric-score contract marks justification optional and the digest...

The system SHALL ensure that the rubric-score contract marks justification optional and the digest renders the Score legend level when it is absent, covered by a digest snapshot test.

#### Scenario: The rubric-score contract marks justification optional and the digest...

WHEN `score-supervise-rubric-stubs-in-one-batched-call` is implemented
THEN The rubric-score contract marks justification optional and the digest renders the Score legend level when it is absent, covered by a digest snapshot test.

### Requirement: Twenty stubs are scored on five factors in one call and the result validates...

The system SHALL ensure that twenty stubs are scored on five factors in one call and the result validates against the updated schema, asserted over a manifest fixture.

#### Scenario: Twenty stubs are scored on five factors in one call and the result validates...

WHEN `score-supervise-rubric-stubs-in-one-batched-call` is implemented
THEN Twenty stubs are scored on five factors in one call and the result validates against the updated schema, asserted over a manifest fixture.

### Requirement: Structural-error handling (missing, partial, invalid, late) is exercised by...

The system SHALL ensure that structural-error handling (missing, partial, invalid, late) is exercised by a test showing the analyst-archetype dispatch remains the fallback.

#### Scenario: Structural-error handling (missing, partial, invalid, late) is exercised by...

WHEN `score-supervise-rubric-stubs-in-one-batched-call` is implemented
THEN Structural-error handling (missing, partial, invalid, late) is exercised by a test showing the analyst-archetype dispatch remains the fallback.

### Requirement: Scores over a recorded manifest agree with the archived analyst output above...

The system SHALL ensure that scores over a recorded manifest agree with the archived analyst output above a recorded agreement rate, cited in the change artifacts.

#### Scenario: Scores over a recorded manifest agree with the archived analyst output above...

WHEN `score-supervise-rubric-stubs-in-one-batched-call` is implemented
THEN Scores over a recorded manifest agree with the archived analyst output above a recorded agreement rate, cited in the change artifacts.
